description: Use action=requirements with no data for the input schema and sources: purchase/BOE/RCM/ISD records, actual GSTR-2B periods, confirmed ITC eligibility and all eight GSTR-3B reversal totals. Authenticated action=validate is free; action=generate needs existing claim access and returns a private JSON download. Money is INR decimal strings. Never guess eligibility, zero reversals or 2B month. No source attachments or credentials. Generation uses live claim entitlements. Separate GST portal validation is required.

filename.description: Unique upload filename without .json. Use a different filename for each part of a split upload.
